&quot;);"><div class="kicker">DVD · 2000. GADI</div><strong>Robby Naish</strong><span>Tolaik DVD, forumi un pieredzes stāsti aizstāja mūsdienu video pamācības.</span></div><div class="retro-item"><div class="kicker">Guide</div><strong>Papīrs + forumi</strong><span>Daudz kas tika saprasts no rakstiem, forumiem un citu pieredzes.</span></div><div class="retro-item"><div class="kicker">Realitāte</div><strong>Daudz kļūdu</strong><span>Tas nebija romantiski — tas bija dārgi, haotiski un reizēm bīstami.</span></div></div><div class="bottom"><p class="quote" data-edit-id="slide-05-text-8">“Mana pirmā sezona bija ļoti garš drošības instrukcijas pārkāpums.”</p><p class="mini" data-edit-id="slide-05-text-9">Šodien drošs sākums = nodarbības pie kvalificēta instruktora.</p></div></section>

Citi izvēlas snovbordu: snowkiting.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="slide" data-slide-id="slide-19"><div class="eyebrow" data-edit-id="slide-19-text-0">17 / PERSONĪGI</div><div class="closing"><div class="number acid" data-edit-id="slide-19-text-1">+2</div><h2 class="heading" data-edit-id="slide-19-text-2">Man ir vēl divas<br><span class="accent">dzimšanas dienas.</span></h2><p class="sub" data-edit-id="slide-19-text-3">Divi notikumi, kas iemācīja: vēju nevar uzvarēt. Ar to var tikai sadarboties.</p><div class="photo" style="max-width: 570px; min-height: 150px; margin-top: 28px;" data-img="media/grey-sea.webp" data-slot-id="slide-19-img-0"><strong>KADRS NO MANA ARHĪVA</strong><span>media/grey-sea.webp</span></div></div></section>

Daudz smilšu. Daudz remonta. Un vēl vairāk brīvības.</p><div class="bottom"><span class="pill" data-edit-id="slide-20-text-3">Paldies!</span><span class="pill" data-edit-id="slide-20-text-4">Jautājumi?</span></div></div></section>

function loadPhoto(el){

 const put=src=>{if(el.dataset.img===path){el.style.backgroundImage=`linear-gradient(0deg,#06121d35,#06121d00),url("${src}")`;el.classList.add('loaded')}};
 el.style.backgroundImage='';el.classList.remove('loaded');
 if(fallback)put(fallback);
 let image=new Image();image.onload=()=>put(preferred);image.onerror=()=>{if(fallback)put(fallback)};image.src=preferred;
 if(preferred===fallback && fallback)put(fallback);
}

function loadBackdrops(){
 function visual(el, prop, path){
   if(!path)return;

   if(local)el.style.setProperty(prop,`url("${local}")`);
   if(preferred!==local){let img=new Image();img.onload=()=>{if((el.dataset.photoBg||el.dataset.backdrop||el.dataset.thumbSrc)===path)el.style.setProperty(prop,`url("${preferred}")`)};img.onerror=()=>{};img.src=preferred;}
   else if(!local)el.style.setProperty(prop,`url("${preferred}")`);
 }
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-backdrop]').forEach(el=>visual(el,'--backdrop',el.dataset.backdrop));
 document.querySelectorAll('.discipline-card[data-photo-bg]').forEach(el=>visual(el,'--discipline',el.dataset.photoBg));
 document.querySelectorAll('.kit-card .img,.safety-visual').forEach(el=>{
   if(!el.dataset.photoBg){let m=(el.style.getPropertyValue('--img')||'').match(/url\(['"]?([^'")]+)['"]?\)/);if(m)el.dataset.photoBg=m[1]}
   visual(el,'--img',el.dataset.photoBg);
 });
 document.querySelectorAll('.btn-thumb').forEach(el=>{
   if(!el.dataset.thumbSrc){let m=(el.style.backgroundImage||'').match(/url\(['"]?([^'")]+)['"]?\)/);if(m)el.dataset.thumbSrc=m[1]}
   const path=el.dataset.thumbSrc;const local=window.KITE_ASSETS?.[path],preferred=window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES?.[path]||local||path;
   if(local)el.style.backgroundImage=`url("${local}")`;
   if(preferred!==local){let img=new Image();img.onload=()=>{if(el.dataset.thumbSrc===path)el.style.backgroundImage=`url("${preferred}")`};img.src=preferred}
 });
 const dvd=document.querySelector('section[data-slide-id="slide-05"] .retro-item:first-child');if(dvd)dvd.style.setProperty('--dvd-photo',`url("${window.KITE_ASSETS['media/wave-action.webp']}")`);
}
window.kiteDeck={go,render,loadPhoto,loadBackdrops,dynamic:{gear,spots,seasons,winds,win},getActive:()=>slides[current],getVisibleSlides:()=>slides};
document.querySelectorAll('.photo').forEach(loadPhoto);loadBackdrops();render();

let albumKeys=[...new Set([...Object.keys(window.KITE_ASSETS).filter(x=>x.startsWith('media/')),...Object.keys(window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES).filter(x=>x.startsWith('custom/'))])];
let albumIndex=0;
let photoReplacePath=null;

  albumKeys.forEach((path,i)=>{let b=document.createElement('button');b.className='lightbox-thumb';b.title=labels[path.split('/').pop().split('.')[0]]||path;b.type='button';
    const img=document.createElement('img');img.loading='lazy';img.src=albumSource(path);img.alt=b.title;b.append(img);b.onclick=()=>showPhoto(i);thumbs.append(b)});
}
function showPhoto(index){
 if(index<0)index=albumKeys.length-1;if(index>=albumKeys.length)index=0;albumIndex=index;

}
function openAlbum(path){if(path&&!albumKeys.includes(path))albumKeys.push(path);if(!albumKeys.length)return;fillThumbs();let i=albumKeys.indexOf(path);showPhoto(i<0?0:i);lightbox.classList.add('open');$('#lightboxClose').focus();}

$('#openGallery').onclick=()=>openAlbum();

    el.setAttribute('aria-label','Atvērt attēlu pilnā izmērā');

  }
  document.querySelectorAll('#gearBtns [data-gear]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',(event)=>{if(!event.isTrusted)return;const path=document.getElementById('gearPhoto')?.dataset.img;if(path)openAlbum(path)}));

$('#lightboxPrev').onclick=()=>showPhoto(albumIndex-1);
$('#lightboxNext').onclick=()=>showPhoto(albumIndex+1);

document.addEventListener('click',e=>{

    return;
  }
  if(document.body.classList.contains('editing')){const el=isEditable(e.target);if(el){selected?.classList.remove('selected-element');selected=el;selected.classList.add('selected-element');$('#hideElement').disabled=false;$('#hideElement').textContent=el.dataset.hidden==='1'?'Показать текст':'Скрыть текст';}}
});

 document.querySelectorAll('[data-edit-id]').forEach(el=>{let x=data.edits?.[el.dataset.editId];if(x){el.innerHTML=x.html;el.dataset.hidden=x.hidden?'1':'0'}});
 if(data.photoOverrides)window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES={...window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES,...data.photoOverrides};
 if(data.imageSlots)Object.entries(data.imageSlots).forEach(([id,v])=>{const el=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot-id]')].find(e=>e.dataset.slotId===id);if(!el)return;
   ['img','photoBg','backdrop','thumbSrc'].forEach(key=>{if(v[key])el.dataset[key]=v[key]});});
 if(data.dynamicOptions)applyDynamicState(data.dynamicOptions);
 albumKeys=[...new Set([...albumKeys,...Object.keys(window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES).filter(x=>x.startsWith('custom/'))])];
 deck.loadBackdrops();document.querySelectorAll('.photo').forEach(deck.loadPhoto);deck.render();onSlideChange();
}
const KEY='kite-editor-'+(document.documentElement.dataset.deckKey||'2026-v2');
function db(){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{if(!indexedDB){reject(new Error('IndexedDB unavailable'));return}let r=indexedDB.open('kitePresentationEditor',2);r.onupgradeneeded=()=>{if(!r.result.objectStoreNames.contains('drafts'))r.result.createObjectStore('drafts');if(!r.result.objectStoreNames.contains('media'))r.result.createObjectStore('media')};r.onsuccess=()=>resolve(r.result);r.onerror=()=>reject(r.error)})}
async function store(val){try{let d=await db();await new Promise((ok,fail)=>{let t=d.transaction('drafts','readwrite');t.objectStore('drafts').put(val,KEY);t.oncomplete=ok;t.onerror=()=>fail(t.error)});d.close();setStatus('Сохранено в этом браузере ✓')}catch(e){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(val));setStatus('Сохранено локально ✓')}catch(e2){setStatus('Память браузера заполнена — скачай редактируемый HTML.')}}}
async function getDraft(){try{let d=await db();let r=await new Promise((ok,fail)=>{let t=d.transaction('drafts','readonly'),q=t.objectStore('drafts').get(KEY);q.onsuccess=()=>ok(q.result);q.onerror=()=>fail(q.error)});d.close();return r||null}catch(e){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'null')}catch(e2){return null}}}
function scheduleSave(){clearTimeout(saveTimer);saveTimer=setTimeout(()=>store(snapshot()),500)}
function saveFile(blob,name){let u=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.download=name;document.body.append(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),2000)}
function exportHTML(makePublic){
 const root=document.documentElement.cloneNode(true),body=root.querySelector('body');body.classList.remove('editing');
 root.dataset.public=makePublic?'true':'false';root.dataset.deckKey='rev-'+Date.now();
 root.querySelector('#quickSaveToast')?.classList.remove('show');
 const toast=root.querySelector('#quickSaveToast');if(toast)toast.textContent='';
 const ov=root.querySelector('#photo-overrides');ov.textContent=JSON.stringify(window.KITE_PHOTO_OVERRIDES).replace(/</g,'\\u003c');
 root.querySelectorAll('[contenteditable]').forEach(el=>el.removeAttribute('contenteditable'));
 root.querySelectorAll('.selected-element').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('selected-element'));
 // Photo
